title: Bounded mismatch-preserving fuzz reproducer minimization
scope: Opt-in deletion reduction of the first PLY/STL mismatch per run, preserving original and Rust success/refusal and every mismatching observation category. Keep unreduced inputs and complete reduced evidence.
open_items: A bounded deletion reducer does not guarantee a globally minimal input.
acceptance: Deterministic bounded reduction preserves success/refusal and all differing observation categories; limits/timeouts never preserve a mismatch.
Real PLY and STL sabotage selfchecks shrink a reproducer and retain independent complete outcomes; ordinary tests cover budget and predicate preservation.
